children: Overview
UK investment trust's half-year NAV total return rose 5.4% to £3.1bln
Company declared 20p per share special dividend, returning 5% of market cap to shareholders
Completed £290mln sale of Stonehage Fleming, largest private asset, with 33% uplift to prior value
Outlook
Company declares special dividend of 20p per share, to be paid on 6 Jan 2027
Company says strong balance sheet enables pursuit of new investment opportunities
Company expects Private Capital allocation to increase as new investments progress
Result Drivers
PUBLIC COMPANIES PERFORMANCE - Public Companies pool generated a 12.3% return, driven by positive share price movements in several holdings and recovery after prior market weakness
PRIVATE CAPITAL REALISATION - Sale of Stonehage Fleming, the largest private asset, contributed to results, though most gains were recognised in the prior year
FUNDS POOL RETURNS - Funds pool delivered a 4.7% return, with Asia holdings benefiting from increased fundraising and IPO activity, while North America distributions remained muted
